transport.header: Valid Unicode-scalar UTF8 Text0..64 bytes; exact echo; missing/wrong-type/duplicates/unknown keys/non-scalar Unicode/over64B refuse BEFORE compiler invocation. Direct raw native outside declared domain unsupported.
transport.integers: Exact JSON signed-int64; Boolean/floating-point not integers.

parser: Always call existing go/strconv:ParseIntDecimal64 on original header, including invalid metadata. Preserve parsed_value and error_kind exactly as its pinned port (0 success,1 syntax,2 range with signed-int64 saturation); this is diagnostics, not admission.

derived_fields.delta_seconds_grammar: Nonempty ASCII digits0..9 only; no trim, sign, separator, HTTP-date or Unicode digits; leading zeros allowed.
derived_fields.delay_in_policy: Valid numeric metadata AND parser success/error0 AND delta grammar AND0<=parsed_value<=max_wait_seconds. Independent of the three confirmation booleans; membership alone is not trusted guidance.
derived_fields.cooldown_active: True only when selected state is WAIT.
derived_fields.remaining_seconds: -1 unless admitted WAIT or READY_TO_REASSESS; WAIT uses delay-elapsed, READY uses0.

arithmetic: No wall clock, absolute timestamp, duration scaling or timestamp arithmetic. Only subtract when0<=elapsed<delay<=max_wait<=86400; elapsed may otherwise span all nonnegative int64 without subtraction.
host_contract: Host establishes selected response/request/whole-operation binding, confirmed header presence, applicability and elapsed observation. A supplied true is not authentication; absence of confirmation is UNKNOWN.
READY_TO_REASSESS schedules a fresh policy assessment. It never manufactures provider ALLOW or ABSENT, dispatch eligibility, authority, a durable claim or a retry-loop effect.
WAIT is a finite time fact, not a server repeat contract. Existing access, whole-operation history, request/key binding, budget and atomic claim obligations remain independent.
Saved replay reconstructs prior facts and cannot establish current guidance or elapsed time.
compatibility: Original bounded composition over an existing Gooo port, not full Go SDK/rate-limiter/HTTP-date/RFC compatibility. The86400 policy maximum and64B header cap are explicit local profile choices; x-ratelimit-reset, multiple-header selection and network effects are absent.

supersedes_unimplemented_proposal.reason: Adopt research recommendation: reuse existing parser and elapsed-seconds facts, avoiding duplicated parser and wall-clock timestamp arithmetic. No candidate/oracle or execution existed for the prior proposal.

validation: Independent Go oracle from this frozen spec using strconv.ParseInt, errors.Is and regexp ASCII grammar; original boundary cases chosen before Gooo output. Actual pinned839 generation/native/saved replay and strict14-field/raw-parent/source/ABI checks remain required.
